change.summary: Operators must exercise due diligence and submit a due diligence statement for commodities linked to deforestation placed on the EU market, with obligations varying by risk classification and enterprise size. The regulation sets a cut-off date of 31 December 2020 and applies to operators, downstream operators, and traders.

obligations.text: Ensure products are deforestation-free after 31 December 2020.
obligations.quote: only products that have been produced on land that has not been subject to deforestation or forest degradation after 31 December 2020 can be placed or made available on the EU market or exported from the EU

reasons: You are established in Germany and ship to multiple EU countries, so you place products on the EU market.
You sell wooden furniture, which falls under the wood commodities covered by the deforestation regulation.
You also sell leather goods, which may fall under cattle commodities also covered by the regulation.

todos.text: Start collecting geolocation data for all wood and leather supply chains to prove no deforestation after 31 December 2020
